description: Preregistered local competition among source-born relation profiles. The benchmark tests selection on Geviert/Saussure/Spinoza, local composition on Aristotle, and abstention on Descartes rather than forcing a universal operator.

candidates.label: Geviert-born co-constitutive gathering profile
candidates.rationale: Born from the Geviert resistant-source run; it must not silently colonize one-way dependence cases.

candidates.label: Saussure-born differential constitution profile
candidates.rationale: Born from a non-Heideggerian differential system; it competes as a local profile rather than a synonym for Geviert.

candidates.label: Spinoza-born asymmetric dependence profile
candidates.rationale: Born from substance-mode asymmetry; its purpose is to block reciprocal flattening.

candidates.label: Aristotle-born local relation-mode variation profile
candidates.rationale: Born from a corpus where substance priority and relatives require different local regimes; it tests composition without a global meta-ontology.

targets.label: Heidegger Geviert
targets.rationale: The origin corpus should locally recover its gathering/proximity profile without importing asymmetry or differential-system operators.

targets.label: Saussure value/difference
targets.rationale: Differential constitution should win without translating langue/value into Geviert.

targets.label: Spinoza substance/mode
targets.rationale: One-way dependence should dominate and reciprocal co-constitution should be penalized.

targets.label: Aristotle substance/relatives
targets.rationale: No single imported profile should erase the fact that different local relation regimes coexist; asymmetry and local variation should compose.

targets.label: Descartes cogito negative control
targets.rationale: A central philosophical source with no relation-genesis profile must be allowed to defeat the entire candidate ecology rather than receive a forced winner.
